summary: This guide breaks down three top-performing team archetypes for Temporal Vortex (stages I through IV): Toxin, Aura, and Dauntless. The boss operates on a strict 20-second skill rotation featuring a massive single-target nuke aimed at the ally with the highest HP, making HP stat manipulation on tanks crucial. Teams utilizing a 3-piece Puppeteer set synchronize their DPS ultimates to an 18-second cycle, timed precisely around debuffs and buffs. Toxin provides massive derivative damage when built around Serpentemis and Lothair/Sleight, while Aura relies on Talethia scaling with max HP, and Dauntless functions as an ultra-high ceiling single-target whale setup led by Guinavivre and Maashtur.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Primary damage dealer for Toxin teams who scales massively off Enlightenment and Attack with Fearless Challenge and Precise Carnage gear.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Excels as a secondary damage dealer whose damage scales on active Toxin stacks; works best with his exclusive artifact Nightfall Pallium.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Provides vital Toxin and Potent Medicine application; equipped with Three-Ears Emblem to amplify team elemental damage.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Must be built with highest team HP to absorb the boss's single-target nuke; his 5-second immortality skill must be timed to 26.5s initial and 20s recast.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides team-wide buffs, debuffs, and cleanses, while his Death's Portent deals massive bonus damage scaling entirely off his Attack stat.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Deals massive damage scaling on max HP, requiring an HP% chest and negative rune while keeping the highest Attack in the Aura team to receive Lincos's buff.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Provides a crucial 30% damage boost for 10s to the Aura ally with highest Attack and wears Puppeteer to enable the 18-second rotation.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Secondary damage dealer built with 230+ Accuracy and Witch's Remains to reliably inflict Defense Penalty II.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Must be geared with highest team HP and Aurelium Vest to tank the single-target boss hit while providing ramping shield value.

heroes.name: Shahla
heroes.note: Increases Critical Damage for the highest Attack Aura ally, though replaceable by Child of Chaos or Anneliesis.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Absorbs the boss's nuke with maximum HP while applying crucial Attack Penalty and team buffs.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Primary single-target damage dealer requiring high Attack Speed, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage to maximize output.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Pairs with Guinavivre to unleash rapid basic attack follow-ups; should have lower Attack than Guinavivre.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: Built with high Attack Speed and Witch's Remains to consistently apply Defense Penalty; can be replaced by Tharivol.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Converts excess Crit Rate into bonus Attack Speed, allowing him to replace Kurvida if built with high Crit Rate.

teams.note: Toxin team running an 18s recast Puppeteer rotation for DPS, with Oggok on a 20s recast (26.5s first cast) to maintain Immortality against the single-target nuke.
Pure Aura team where Talethia must have highest Attack to get Lincos's 30% damage buff, while Solmo stacks highest HP to tank single-target hits.
Upgraded Aura variant substituting Shahla for Child of Chaos in Puppeteer gear, yielding 2.8B+ total damage.
High-investment Dauntless whale team utilizing Starlight Stoneborn familiar and 18s rotations to deliver immense single-target damage.

tips: Always ensure your designated tank (Oggok, Solmo, Maashtur, or Frurbath) has the absolute highest maximum HP on the team to intercept the boss's 20-second single-target nuke.
Do not make Child of Chaos your highest HP hero because his passive immunity prevents him from receiving Oggok's Immortality buff, which will get him one-shot.
Equip one support hero with a 3-piece Puppeteer set to recharge 10% ultimate energy, cutting full skill rotations from 20s down to 18s.
Set Oggok's ultimate timing to a 26.5s initial cast and 20.0s recast so Immortality always aligns with the boss's single-target strike.
For Talethia, run HP% on the chest and negative rune rather than pure Attack, because her skills scale heavily with maximum HP.
Time your damage amplifying familiar (such as Lava Batwing or Starlight Stoneborn) to cast roughly 2 seconds prior to your main damage dealers' ultimates.
title: Build Your Temporal Vortex Teams the Right Way! Toxin, Dauntless & Aura Guide | Dragonheir
